# War Scroll Column 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 2 | **Condition:** complete

---

**2:1** [...] the rule-of the heads of the camps-of the congregation; between forty and fifty years-of age. And the organizers-of the camps shall-be between fifty and sixty years-of age. And the officers

**2:2** [...] shall-be between forty and fifty years-of age. And all those who strip-the-slain and who plunder-the-spoil and who cleanse-the-land and who guard-the-weapons

**2:3** and he-who-prepares the provisions, all-these shall-be between twenty-five and thirty years-of age. And no youth or woman shall enter their camps when they go-forth from Jerusalem

**2:4** to-go to-war, until their return. And no lame-one or blind-one or crippled-one, or a man having in-his-flesh a permanent blemish, or a man smitten with an uncleanness-of

**2:5** his flesh — all-these shall not go-forth with-them to-war. All-of-them shall-be men-of volunteers for-war, perfect-of spirit and flesh, and prepared for the day-of vengeance. And any

**2:6** man who is not pure with-regard-to his genitals on the day-of battle shall not go-down with-them into-battle, for holy angels-are together with their armies. And a space

**2:7** shall-be between all their camps and the place-of the hand [latrine], about two-thousand cubits, and no unseemly nakedness-of anything shall-be-seen in the surroundings of all their camps.

**2:8** And when they arrange-the-battle-lines for-war, to marshal-the-front-line, there-shall-be between the lines a space-of about seven

**2:9** lots with-horsemen at-their right and at-their left. And the width-of the gap between the lines shall-be seven cubits for the formations-of

**2:10** the men-of-war. And the trumpets-of summoning-of the congregation they-shall-write upon-them: "Called-ones-of God." And upon the trumpets-of summoning-of the leaders they-shall-write:

**2:11** "Princes-of God." And upon the trumpets-of the enrollment they-shall-write: "The-Order-of God." And upon the trumpets-of the notable-men, the heads-of

**2:12** the fathers-of the congregation, when they are-assembled at the meeting-house, they-shall-write: "Testimonies-of God for the Holy-Council."

**2:13** And upon the trumpets-of the camps they-shall-write: "The-Peace-of God in the camps-of his holy-ones." And upon the trumpets-of breaking-camp they-shall-write:

**2:14** "The-Mighty-Acts-of God to-scatter the enemy and to-put-to-flight all-those-who-hate righteousness, and a withdrawing-of covenant-faithfulness from all-who-hate God."

**2:15** And upon the trumpets-of the battle-formations they-shall-write: "Formations-of the divisions-of God for the vengeance-of his anger against all the Sons-of-Darkness."

**2:16** And upon the trumpets-of summoning of the infantry, when the gates-of war are-opened for the men-of-the-infantry to-go-forth, they-shall-write: "A reminder-of vengeance in the appointed-time-of God."

---

*EMET notes: Column 2 details trumpet inscriptions for various stages of assembly and battle. Hyphenated constructs preserve the Hebrew nominal chains characteristic of liturgical-military terminology. "Place-of the hand" (yad) for latrine follows the Hebrew euphemism. "Covenant-faithfulness" for hesed throughout. All trumpet inscriptions preserved as Hebrew construct phrases.*
